_meta.note: Source strings. Every other language falls back to these.

undo.sensei: No worries. Tap Undo if that was a slip.
mode.title: Show all features
mode.hint: Simple mode shows the core screens. Turn this on to see everything. Nothing is ever deleted.
mode.sensei: I will keep it simple for now. More unlocks as you go.
lang.title: Language
lang.hint: Menus, coach messages and reminders. Anything not translated yet stays in English.
lang.review: Hindi, Telugu and Tamil are first drafts and still need a native review.
next.breakfast.text: Good morning! Log your breakfast, even a rough guess is fine.
next.water-am.text: A glass of water first thing is an easy start.
next.lunch.text: Lunch time. Log it when you eat, so the day stays simple.
next.water.text: Your water is a little behind. A glass now helps.
next.steps.text: A 10-minute walk fits nicely into this part of the day.
next.fix.text: A little over today is fine. Want a light plan for the rest of the day?
next.dinner.text: Dinner time. Log it so tomorrow can build on today.
next.weight.text: It is your weigh-in day. A quick entry is enough.
next.wind-down.text: Nice work today. Prepare tomorrow's plan, then rest well.
next.late-lunch.text: Did you eat lunch? Log it so your day stays accurate.
next.steady.text: You are on track. Log what you eat as you go.
palette.title: Quick add
palette.placeholder: Type a command, e.g. water 250, weight 70.5, food rice
palette.hint: Enter to run · Esc to close
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.goto: Go to Home / Food / Plan / Progress
notif.water: Time for a glass of water
notif.breakfast: Breakfast time. A quick log is enough.
notif.lunch: Lunch time. Log it when you eat.
notif.dinner: Dinner time. Log it so tomorrow can build on today.
say.welcome: Welcome. I am your sensei here. We start small.
say.palette: Quick add ready. Type what you did.
a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.largeHint: Makes text and buttons about 20% bigger on this device.
a11y.phoneHint: Text size follows your phone's font size setting (Settings, Display).
checkin.title: Quick check-in
coach.failed: The coach could not load. Check your connection and try again.
coach.next.label: YOUR NEXT STEP
coach.next.decision.detail: Your coach has one change for this week. Review it and tap to apply, or leave it.
coach.next.checkin.title: Do your 10-second check-in
coach.next.checkin.detail: Sleep, energy and soreness. It makes today's workout and this week's plan fit how you actually feel.
coach.next.train.title: Today: your workout
coach.next.train.detail: Your planned session is on today. Do it at the effort your check-in suggests.
coach.next.log.title: Log your first meal
coach.next.log.detail: The plan only adapts to what it can see. One meal logged is a good start.
coach.next.steady.title: You are on track today
coach.next.steady.detail: Keep logging and keep moving. The coach will tell you if anything needs to change.
coach.band.green: You are well recovered. Train as planned.
coach.band.amber: A little tired. Same session, about 5% lighter, and stop with one more rep in reserve.
coach.band.red: Low recovery today. Do the Quick 20, or one set fewer at about 10% lighter. A light session keeps the habit without digging a deeper hole.
coach.checkin.title: 10-second check-in
coach.checkin.hint: Two answers or more. It fits today's workout to how you feel.
coach.checkin.saved: Check-in saved. Today's plan now fits how you feel.
coach.queued: Saved on this device. It will be sent when you are back online.
coach.weekly.title: This week: {headline}
coach.weekly.applied: Applied. The coach now waits to see the effect before changing anything else.
coach.weekly.appliedAuto: Applied automatically. The coach now waits to see the effect before changing anything else.
coach.weekly.outliers: {n} unusual weigh-in(s) left out so one odd reading does not move your plan.
coach.refreshed.recovery-low: Updated early because your recovery has been low this week.
coach.refreshed.trend-fast: Updated early because your weight trend is dropping faster than is safe.
coach.refreshed.recovery-back: Updated early because your recovery is back to normal.
coach.refreshed.strength: Updated early because your lifts changed.
coach.refreshed.measurement: Updated early because of your new waist measurement.
coach.refreshed.data: Updated early because there is now enough data to read.
coach.apply.pace: Raise my pace to {pace} kg a week
coach.apply.done: Done. I will check the effect before changing anything else.
coach.apply.queuedTap: Saved. It will apply when you are back online, if the suggestion is still the same.
coach.forecast.title: When you will get there
coach.training.title: Training: {phase}
coach.day.macros: Protein {p} g · Carbs {c} g · Fat {f} g
coach.rest.title: Rest of today
coach.auto.title: Safe auto-adjust
coach.auto.detail: Let the coach apply small changes for you (up to 150 kcal, or a higher steps goal). Bigger changes always wait for your tap, and any change can be undone.
coach.auto.on: Small changes will now apply automatically.
coach.auto.off: Every change now waits for your tap.
coach.undo.title: Last change
coach.undo.done: Put back. The coach will not change this automatically for 14 days.
coach.log.title: What your coach changed
coach.offer.title: About {weeks} weeks behind your target date
coach.offer.body: At your current pace you would reach your goal around {date}. Two ways to close the gap: you choose, and nothing changes until you tap.
coach.offer.date.title: Move the date to {date}
coach.offer.date.detail: Your plan stays as it is and the date becomes honest. No extra hunger.
coach.offer.pace.title: Raise the pace to {to} kg a week
coach.offer.pace.detail: About {perDay} kcal less a day ({kcal} kcal). You would reach your goal around {finish}.
coach.offer.pace.onTime: That gets you there by your date.
coach.offer.caveat: A bigger deficit only helps if your food logging is accurate.
coach.offer.noPace.adherence: A faster pace comes after more days close to plan.
coach.offer.noPace.recovery: A faster pace waits until your recovery is back.
coach.offer.noPace.strength: A faster pace waits until your lifts recover.
coach.offer.noPace.diet-break: A faster pace waits until your diet break is over.
coach.offer.noPace.under-eating: A faster pace is not safe while you are eating below your minimum.
coach.offer.noPace.floor: Your calories are already at the safe minimum.
coach.offer.noPace.safe-limit: You are already near the fastest safe pace.
coach.offer.snoozed: OK. I will not bring this up for two weeks.
coach.cycle.title: Cycle (optional)
coach.cycle.intro: Log the day a period starts and the coach will not mistake the monthly water shift for a stalled diet. Private, off by default, and you can erase it any time.
coach.cycle.water: Water often rises around now, so a flat scale says little about fat.
coach.cycle.stale: Your last logged period was a while ago. Log the next one to keep this useful.
coach.w.UNDER_EATING.head: You are eating below your safe minimum
coach.w.NEED_PROFILE.head: Finish your profile first
coach.w.NEED_DATA.head: Not enough weigh-ins yet
coach.w.NEED_FOOD_LOGS.head: Log your food on more days
coach.w.TOO_FAST_RAISE.head: Losing faster than is safe
coach.w.FIX_ADHERENCE.head: Follow the plan first
coach.w.PROTECT_MUSCLE.head: Protect your muscle
coach.w.DIET_BREAK_DUE.head: Time for a planned diet break
coach.w.ON_TRACK.head: On track
coach.w.FIX_HEAVY_DAYS.head: Heavy days are slowing you down
coach.w.EXPLAINED_BY_HEAVY_DAY.head: A heavy day explains it
coach.w.RESTORE_TRAINING.head: Get the training back first
coach.w.HIT_STEPS.head: Hit your steps first
coach.w.COMPOSITION_IMPROVING.head: The scale is slow, but your body is changing
coach.w.WAIT_RETENTION.head: Water weight may be hiding progress
coach.w.WAIT_CYCLE.head: Your cycle may be hiding progress
coach.w.WAIT_EFFECT.head: Give the last change time
coach.w.WAIT_ONE_MORE.head: Slightly slow: one more week
coach.w.LADDER_WALK.head: Step 2: add one incline walk a week
coach.w.HOLD_STRENGTH.head: Strength first, no cut
coach.w.HOLD_RECOVERY.head: Recovery first, no cut
coach.w.LADDER_CUT.head: Step 3: cut {kcal} kcal (carbs first)
coach.w.LADDER_BREAK.head: Step 4: a 7-day diet break
coach.w.LADDER_STEPS.head: Step 1: raise steps to {to}
coach.w.REASSESS.head: Time to reassess
coach.w.TARGET_DATE.head: Move your target date
coach.w.RAISE_PACE.head: Raise your planned pace
coach.w.ON_TRACK.m1: Your trend is {rate} kg a week against a plan of {plan}. Change nothing.
coach.w.NEED_DATA.m1: I need at least {min} weigh-ins in 14 days (you have {have}). Weigh yourself each morning and I will read the trend. No changes until then.
coach.w.NEED_FOOD_LOGS.m1: Only {food} of the last 14 days have food logged. Without it I cannot tell a plan problem from a logging problem, so nothing changes.
coach.w.WAIT_ONE_MORE.m1: Your trend is {rate} kg a week against {plan}. One slow week is noise: I will look again next week before changing anything.
coach.w.FIX_ADHERENCE.m1: Only {adh}% of days were close to plan. Slow progress here is a behaviour problem, so no cut. Pick ONE fix: prep lunch, a planned flex meal, or an earlier dinner.
coach.w.HIT_STEPS.m1: You average {avg} steps against {target}. Do not cut food for an activity problem: reach your steps first.
coach.w.RESTORE_TRAINING.m1: You trained {sessions} days a week against {planned} planned. Slow progress here is an activity problem, so food stays as it is. No doubling up and no punishment cardio.
coach.w.LADDER_STEPS.m1: Two slow weeks with good adherence. The cheapest lever is walking: +{plus} steps a day costs no hunger.
coach.w.WAIT_CYCLE.m1: You are around day {day} of a {len}-day cycle. Water often rises in the week before a period and the first days of it, then drops, so a flat scale now says little about fat. I wait one more week before changing anything. Compare the same part of the cycle from month to month.
coach.adv.strength-down.title: Strength is falling while you diet
coach.adv.deficit-protected.title: Your deficit is working and muscle is safe
coach.adv.deficit-protected.detail: Weight is falling at a good pace and your lifts are rising. Do not cut further: this is the best case.
coach.adv.protein-low.title: Protein is under target
coach.adv.protein-low.detail: You averaged about {avg} g against {target} g. Training only builds or keeps muscle when protein is there: add a serving of dal, curd, egg or paneer to the meal that is lowest.
coach.adv.break-with-deload.title: Good week for a diet break
coach.adv.break-with-deload.detail: You have been in a deficit for about {weeks} weeks and your training is in its easy week. Doing the 7-day diet break now lets food and training recover together.
coach.adv.break-keep-lifting.title: Diet break: keep lifting normally
coach.adv.break-keep-lifting.detail: Food is at maintenance this week. Keep the same weights; you will probably feel stronger.
coach.adv.low-recovery.title: Recovery is low this week
coach.body.title: Body progress
coach.body.empty: Not enough data yet. Weigh in often, log your food and measure your waist every two weeks.
coach.body.fat.title: What is changing: fat or muscle
coach.body.fat.v.fat-loss: Mostly fat is coming off. Keep going.
coach.body.fat.v.recomp: Fat is coming off while muscle holds or grows. This is the best case.
coach.body.fat.v.muscle-loss: Some of the loss may be muscle. Eat enough protein, keep lifting and do not cut further.
coach.body.fat.v.fat-gain: Fat seems to be rising. Check your food and steps.
coach.body.fat.v.unclear: No clear change yet. Keep measuring.
coach.body.fat.detail: Waist {waist} cm over about 6 weeks. About {fat} kg fat (likely {fatLo} to {fatHi}) and {lean} kg lean (likely {leanLo} to {leanHi}). Tape estimates are good for change over time, not exact.
coach.body.fat.tape: Waist changed {waist} cm over about 6 weeks. Add a neck measurement for a fat and muscle estimate.
coach.body.recomp.title: Progress without the scale moving
coach.body.recomp.detail: Your scale is flat but your waist is {waist} cm smaller and your lifts hold. Do not cut calories: this is working.
coach.body.ratio.title: Waist and height
coach.body.ratio.detail: Your waist is {whtr} of your height. Under 0.5 is a good aim: about {cm} cm to go.
coach.body.ratio.ok: Your waist is {whtr} of your height: in the healthy range.
coach.body.maint.title: What your body really burns
coach.body.maint.detail: About {est} kcal a day (likely {lo} to {hi}), against {exp} from the formula. Confidence: {conf}.
coach.body.maint.need: Needs about {w} more weigh-ins, {d} more days of history and {l} more logged days.
coach.body.gap.title: Some food may be missing from your log
coach.body.gap.detail: Your weight moves about {kcal} kcal a day less than your log predicts. Most often this is food that never got logged.
coach.body.gap.fix.weigh-food: Weigh your food for one week instead of estimating.
coach.body.gap.fix.oil: Count cooking oil, ghee and butter.
coach.body.gap.fix.drinks: Log chai, juices and other drinks.
coach.body.drop.title: Your daily movement has dropped
coach.body.drop.detail: Steps fell {pct}% (from {before} to {now} a day). Get back to about {floor} before cutting food.
coach.body.pace.title: Is your pace sensible for your body?
coach.body.pace.fast: Your pace is above what is sensible for your size (about {max} kg a week at most). Fast loss costs muscle.
coach.body.pace.ok: Your pace is within a sensible range (up to about {max} kg a week).
coach.body.pace.slow: Your pace is very gentle (up to about {max} kg a week is fine). Faster is possible if you want it.
coach.body.taper.title: Ease the pace for the final stretch
coach.body.taper.detail: {remaining} kg to go. Easing from {from} to {to} kg a week (about {more} kcal more food) makes the finish easier to hold. You would still finish in about {weeks} weeks.
coach.apply.taper: Ease my pace to {pace} kg a week
coach.body.pc.title: Slow progress: check in this order
coach.body.pc.data.fix: Weigh in each morning: you have {have} of {need} in 14 days.
coach.body.pc.water.maybe: Water can hide fat loss for a week or two. Wait before changing anything.
coach.body.pc.logging.fix: Only {pct}% of days are logged. Log more days before judging the plan.
coach.body.pc.logging.maybe: About {kcal} kcal a day may be missing from your log.
coach.body.pc.activity.fix: Steps fell {pct}%: get back to about {floor} a day.
coach.body.pc.adaptation.maybe: Your body may burn about {kcal} kcal less than the formula says. A diet break or a maintenance week can help.
coach.body.fatigue.title: Diet fatigue: {band}
coach.body.fatigue.break: A planned diet break would help now.
coach.body.real.title: Your goal and the way there
coach.body.real.ok: Your goal looks realistic at this pace.
coach.body.real.ambitious: Your date is tight: at this pace you need about {need} weeks and have about {avail}.
coach.body.real.too-fast: This pace is faster than the safe limit.
coach.body.real.too-low: This goal weight is below the healthy range for your height.
coach.body.real.lean: This is a lean goal. Take it slowly and keep lifting.
coach.body.ms.title: Milestones
coach.body.ms.review: Next 4-week check-in: {date}. Weigh, measure and compare.
coach.body.keep.title: Staying at your goal
coach.body.keep.detail: Keep your weight between {low} and {high} kg. Raise food by about 125 kcal a week until you reach about {kcal} kcal.
coach.body.guard.watch: You are {over} kg above your band. Watch it this week.
coach.body.guard.act: You are {over} kg above your band. For two weeks eat about 125 kcal less a day and add 1,000 steps.
coach.body.sc.title: What would change your date
coach.body.leak.title: Where calories leak
coach.body.leak.weekend: Weekends run about {kcal} kcal a day higher than weekdays.
coach.body.leak.heavy-days: {n} heavy days in the last two weeks.
coach.body.leak.weekend.fix: Plan weekend meals ahead and keep protein high.
coach.body.leak.heavy-days.fix: Pick one fix: prep lunch, a planned treat, or an earlier dinner.
coach.body.leak.snacks.fix: Swap one snack for fruit, curd or a set portion of nuts.
coach.body.leak.dinner.fix: Move some food to lunch so dinner is lighter.
coach.body.nut.title: Protein and fullness
coach.body.nut.protein-spread: Only {pct}% of your main meals reach 20 g of protein. Spread protein across meals to stay full and keep muscle.
coach.body.nut.fibre-low: Fibre averages {avg} g a day. Add vegetables, dal and fruit to feel fuller on fewer calories.
coach.body.learned.title: What has worked for you
coach.body.learned.best.steps: Raising your steps has helped you most so far.
coach.body.learned.best.walk: Adding walks has helped you most so far.
coach.body.learned.best.cut: Small calorie cuts have helped you most so far.
coach.body.learned.best.break: Diet breaks have helped you most so far.
coach.body.learned.best.pace: Changing your pace has helped you most so far.
coach.body.learned.none: Not enough judged changes yet to say what works best for you.
coach.body.measure.title: Measure more of your body
coach.body.measure.detail: Once a month, measure your {parts} in the morning, relaxed, at the same spot. Take the average of 3.
